  (g : Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_1 + 1} Y E)

      (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp.{u_1, u_1 + 1} (SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.prismEndpoint.{u_1} 1 X) H)

      (CategoryTheory.SemiCartesianMonoidalCategory.fst.{u_1, u_1 + 1}
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{0, u_1, 0, u_1 + 1} SSet.stdSimplex.{u_1} { len := 1 }) X) →
    Eq.{u_1 + 1} (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp.{u_1, u_1 + 1} g p)
        (SSet.const.{u_1} ((Equiv.symm.{u_1 + 1, 1} SSet.stdSimplex.obj₀Equiv.{u_1}) 1)) →
      ∀
        (z0 :
          Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_1 + 1} X
            (SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.vertexFiber.{u_1} p
              ((Equiv.symm.{u_1 + 1, 1} SSet.stdSimplex.obj₀Equiv.{u_1}) 0))),
        Eq.{u_1 + 1}
            (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp.{u_1, u_1 + 1} z0
              (SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.vertexFiberι.{u_1} p
                ((Equiv.symm.{u_1 + 1, 1} SSet.stdSimplex.obj₀Equiv.{u_1}) 0)))
            (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp.{u_1, u_1 + 1}
              (SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.prismEndpoint.{u_1} 0 X) H) →
          ∀
            (z1 :
              Quiver.Hom.{u_1, u_1 + 1} Y
                (SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.vertexFiber.{u_1} p
                  ((Equiv.symm.{u_1 + 1, 1} SSet.stdSimplex.obj₀Equiv.{u_1}) 1))),
            Eq.{u_1 + 1}
                (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp.{u_1, u_1 + 1} z1
                  (SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.vertexFiberι.{u_1} p
                    ((Equiv.symm.{u_1 + 1, 1} SSet.stdSimplex.obj₀Equiv.{u_1}) 1)))
                g →
              SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsPrecompositionEquivalence.{u_1} z0 →
                SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsPrecompositionEquivalence.{u_1} z1 →
                  (∀ (x : CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{0, u_1, 0, u_1 + 1} X (Opposite.op.{1} { len := 0 })),
                      SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsCocartesianEdge.{u_1} p
                        (SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.prismVerticalSimplex.{u_1} H x)) →
                    SerrePositivity.InfinityCategories.IsPrecompositionEquivalence.{u_1}
                      (CategoryTheory.Limits.pushout.desc.{u_1, u_1 + 1} H g w)
